title: Level three and the road to the tournament
summary: Tian Buyi and Su Ru stop the fight between Lin Jingyu and Tian Ling'er. Qi Hao apologises for his junior and gives Ling'er a cooling pearl, which she accepts. Lin Jingyu and Zhang Xiaofan promise to do their best at the Seven Meridians Tournament, held every 60 years, and make Grass Temple Village proud. That night Ling'er gives Xiaofan her own copy of the third level of the Taiji Xuanqing method and tells him not to be bullied again; he practises it and finds its qi flows smoothly and feels like the Brahma Prajna. Du Bishu comes back after six years with his Godwood Dice, a flying treasure. On Dragon Head Peak, Lin Jingyu masters a powerful Dragon-Slaying Sword move, and Cang Song, in the hall of ancestral tablets, insists good and evil must be kept apart and he wants the cleanest world. Great Bamboo Peak sets off for the tournament. Xiaofan brings a black stick instead of a sword, rides with Song Daren, falls off on the way, and arrives with the others at the gathering.

flags: This episode's English track uses different terms: 'Seven Pulse Martial Art Contest' (EP4/6: 'Duel of Seven Ranges'), 'Way of Taichi Xuanqing' (EP3/4: 'Qing Method of Taijixuan'), 'uncle Su' for Su Ru. Mapped to the Seven Meridians Tournament and Taiji Xuanqing.

298-308 s: Ling'er says someone 'lost to no one but Qi Hao' in the last tournament; who is unclear (probably Song Daren, since she answers 'We have Daren'). In EP6 Qi Hao says he lost to 'Xiao' last time.
603-660 s: a secret letter, then Cang Song argues in the ancestral hall with a voice (captions are the tablet texts on yin and yang). The other speaker is not identified.
803-830 s: Xiaofan falls off during the flight; someone he calls 'Elder...' is there when he lands. Not clear who.
746.0 s 'Wang to fly on magic dice?' is a typo for 'Want'.
